plain_text:
An adult Western centered on U.S. Marshal Matt Dillon and the people of Dodge City, using frontier crime and conflict to tell unusually serious stories about law, violence, survival, and community.

Adult-oriented CBS Western set in and around Dodge City. GRH contains 474 playable archive objects.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS radio run (April 26, 1952 to June 18, 1961) on CBS Radio Network.

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include William Conrad (performer and writer), Parley Baer (performer), Georgia Ellis (performer), George Walsh (announcer), Howard McNear (performer), Norman Macdonnell (director, producer, and writer), and John Meston (writer, editorial supervisor, and story editor).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to CBS Radio Network and Armed Forces Radio and Television Service.

The stories often return to Murder and violent crime, Frontier law enforcement, Family and domestic conflict, Robbery and theft, Cattle and ranching, and Frontier medicine.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Adult-oriented radio Western, Radio and television Gunsmoke overlap, and Late network-radio drama.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Escape, Lux Radio Theatre, The Adventures of Philip Marlowe, and Have Gun, Will Travel.
